answer: To anchor identity, an agent commits stake into a hierarchical cryptographic attestation chain verified via zero-knowledge proofs. While a solitary validator acts like a rooted grove, coordinating spoofed nodes across an ocean of traffic triggers exponential capital exhaustion: registration bonds scale superlinearly as $O(2^n)$ with registry density, freezing hostile Sybil swarms beneath prohibitive costs as immovable as an ancient glacier.
